class.name: RainFall3D
class.brief_description: Falling rain round the camera: streaks, splashes, drips from leaves and eaves, and haze, from [WeatherMap3D].
class.description: Draws the rain [WeatherMap3D] puts at the camera: drops sized by Marshall and Palmer (1948), falling at their terminal speed (Atlas et al. 1973) in the weather's wind, drawn as streaks one exposure long (Garg and Nayar 2006) that refract under the path tracer. Drops splash where the Yarin and Weiss (1995) splash parameter allows, and on water. Leaves and eaves found round the camera drip by the weather's canopy water (Rutter's model) and a roof store, and keep dripping after the rain. The drops thicken the air (extinction from their sizes). With [WeatherMap3D] splitting rain and snow by temperature, it draws the rain's share and [SnowFall3D] the snow's. See docs/ideas/rain.md.

method.name: drips_per_second
method.description: Drops (each [param drop_mm] across) per second an area of [param area_m2] sheds draining [param rate_mm_h] mm/h.

method.name: drop_number_density
method.description: Drops per m³ larger than [param min_size_mm] in rain of [param rate_mm_h] mm/h (Marshall and Palmer 1948).

method.name: drop_size_slope
method.description: Marshall and Palmer's slope (per mm) of the drop sizes at [param rate_mm_h] mm/h: 4.1 R^-0.21.

method.name: get_body_count
method.description: The moving bodies the drops meet this frame (see [member body_collision]).

method.name: get_drip_rate
method.description: Drips falling each second within [member drip_extent].

method.name: get_drip_source_count
method.description: The leaves and eaves dripping now.

method.name: get_drop_weight
method.description: How many real drops each drawn drop stands for.

method.name: get_extinction
method.description: The rain's extinction (per metre) from its drop sizes, set on the weather's haze.

method.name: get_rain_share
method.description: The share of the precipitation falling as rain at the camera.

method.name: get_visibility
method.description: The distance (m) the rain's extinction leaves (3.912 over the extinction).

method.name: impact_flux
method.description: Drops between [param min_size_mm] and [param max_size_mm] landing on a square metre each second at [param rate_mm_h] mm/h.

method.name: rain_extinction
method.description: The extinction (per m) of rain at [param rate_mm_h] mm/h, by geometric optics: about 1.5 per km at 10 mm/h.

method.name: splash_parameter
method.description: Yarin and Weiss's splash parameter K = We Oh^-0.4 for a drop [param size_mm] across at [param speed] m/s; a crown forms above about 2,100.

method.name: terminal_velocity
method.description: A drop's terminal speed (m/s) at sea level, Atlas et al. (1973): 9.65 - 10.3 exp(-0.6 D).

members.member: When enabled, rain and drips land on moving bodies near the camera (characters, vehicles, rigid props: every body in the physics space that is not static), splashing on them as on the ground: the physics space's broadphase finds up to 16 nearest each frame, and their sphere, capsule, cylinder, box and convex shapes (a convex hull as its box) go to the particles as analytic colliders. Static surfaces are left to the shelter heightfield.
Physics layers of the moving bodies rain and drips land on.
Scales the number of drops drawn.
Physics layers cast against to find eaves and the ground under drips.
The square (m) round the camera where leaves and eaves drip.
A drip's diameter (mm): about 4.5 by Tate's law.
Drips from leaves and eaves, after the rain too.
Scales the drawn width of drops.
The least drop (m) below a roof's edge for it to count as an eave.
The box (m) round the camera that drops fall through.
Draw the falling drops.
The node the rain follows; the current camera when empty.
Set the rain's extinction on the weather's haze, so far rain reads as mist.
The most drips drawn at once.
The most drops drawn at once.
Drops smaller than this (mm) are not drawn.
A rain rate (mm/h) to draw instead of the weather's; below 0, the weather's.
How far (m) back from an eave the roof drains to it.
The time (s) a roof takes to drain to its eaves after the rain.
Keep rain out from under roofs and trees with a height field seen from above.
Render layers that shelter from the rain.
A [SnowCover3D] whose surface stops the drops. When empty, the snow contract ([code]WorldContracts.get_snow()[/code]) gives the snow top, ruts and footprints included.
Splashes where drops land.
The exposure (s) a streak's length shows.
Scales the eddies in the wind the drops fall through.
